classical_hed_watershed.architecture: Ruifrok-Johnston Optical Density Deconvolution + Distance Transform + Marker Watershed

stardist.detection_approach: Star-convex polygon ray regression from predicted object centers

cellpose.detection_approach: Vector flow-field tracking of diffusion gradient sinks
cellpose.he_compatibility: Moderate (predominantly trained on fluorescence microscopy, adaptable to H&E)

hover_net.detection_approach: Horizontal/Vertical distance gradients + multi-task nuclear classification
hover_net.he_compatibility: Very High (specifically designed for H&E WSIs; CoNSeP/PanNuke)
hover_net.simultaneous_classification: Yes (predicts neoplastic, inflammatory, stromal, necrotic phenotypes)
hover_net.cpu_feasibility: Slow (~3.5s per tile on CPU due to 3 heavy branches)
